# Rudra Sacred — llms.txt
# A short guide to rudrasacred.in for AI search and assistants.
# English only. All facts below are as stated on the site itself.

## About
Rudra Sacred (rudrasacred.in) is an Indian online store for rudraksha beads,
malas, crystals, bracelets and traditional puja essentials. The store is run
by a direct manufacturer: products are made, checked and prepared in-house,
kept in stock, and energised as per tradition before dispatch. Orders ship
across India with free shipping. Secure payments by UPI, cards and net
banking; cash on delivery is available on eligible orders. Prices are shown
in INR, inclusive of all taxes. No outcome or benefit is guaranteed for any
product; traditional associations are described as matters of belief.

## Product pages
Every product has its own page under https://rudrasacred.in/products/<slug>/,
with its name, price, contents, specifications and a certificate of
authenticity image. Product data is also published as JSON-LD (Product and
Offer schema) on each product page.
